recommendation_rationale: Strong operational leader with 3.75/5 narrative quality and clear execution excellence. However, two critical disqualifiers: (1) Only 1 year direct banking experience when JD requires 10 years (explicit, repeated requirement); (2) REWRITE NOTES section in resume reveals artificial positioning and damages credibility. Education mismatch (MSW vs. required field) adds third concern. Candidate would likely be auto-rejected at ATS level before reaching hiring manager. Exception pathway only viable through internal referral + direct phone screen.
